scenes.headline: Your first steps in **forex trading**
scenes.sub: What to learn, practise and check before your first trade.

scenes.heading: What is **forex?**
body: Forex is the global market for exchanging currencies. Prices move as supply and demand change.
Currencies are traded in pairs, like EUR/USD. When you trade a pair, you buy one currency and sell the other.
scenes.tip: Start on a free demo account: same platform, virtual funds.

scenes.heading: Before every **trade**
scenes.sub: Tick each box. If one is missing, wait.
items: I know why I am entering this trade
I risk only a small share of my balance
I know the next economic news time
I wrote the trade in my journal
scenes.tip: Leverage can increase losses as well as gains.

scenes.heading: Weekly **outlook**
scenes.sub: Key levels to watch this week.

scenes.heading: Trade with **ABET**
scenes.sub: One account, the markets you know.

points.text: Practise, then trade with a plan
